$comment: High/critical advisories in development-only dependencies that have no fixed release yet. Read by scripts/audit-dev.mjs (CI). Each entry expires: after that date CI fails again until the entry is renewed with a reason or removed. Production dependencies never get exceptions (npm audit --omit=dev runs separately, any severity fails).

exceptions.reason: ReDoS through repeated extglobs. No fixed release exists (every version up to the latest, 4.0.7, is affected). Used only by development tools (eslint-config-next via micromatch, Vite, Vitest), which match glob patterns from this repository's own configuration, never user input; nothing of it ships in the site.
